article.title: Saving of donations mortis causa and Muhammadan law.
article.content: Nothing in this Chapter related to gifts of moveable property made in contemplation of death, or shall be deemed to affect any rule of Muhammadan law 2***.
article.html:
129Saving of donations mortis causa and Muhammadan law.

Section 129 · Chapter VII · page 44 of the Act

Nothing in this Chapter related to gifts of moveable property made in contemplation of death, or shall be deemed to affect any rule of Muhammadan law 2***.

2 The words and figures “or, save as provided by s. 123, any rule of Hindu or Buddhist law” omitted by Act 20 of 1929, s. 61.
